data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'lebē', meaning 'to be devoted' or 'to dedicate'. In ancient Greece, Lebo was a personal name given to children who were dedicated to the gods. In Christianity, this name symbolizes a deep commitment and devotion to God.
